Class Factory<T>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.inject.context.Factory<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the built type
All Implemented Interfaces:
BeanDefinition
public abstract class Factory<T> extends Object implements BeanDefinition
Base class for per-bean factories. Generated subclasses live in the bean's own package so they can access package-private members with zero reflection.

A factory is also the BeanDefinition for its bean: the read-only introspection view exposed through the container is this instance.

    • supertypeKeys

      protected List<Key<?>> supertypeKeys()
      Returns the keys among exposedKeys() the bean has only through its supertypes; none by default.

      Such a key binds the bean when no other binding claims it. When several beans have it this way and nothing else binds it, it is left unbound: an injection point depending on it is an error, naming those beans.

      Returns:
      the keys among exposedKeys() the bean has only through its supertypes; none by default

    • contribution

    • getProviderForConstructor

      protected final <D> Provider<D> getProviderForConstructor(int paramIndex, Class<? super D> type, Context context)
      Returns the provider for the paramIndex-th constructor parameter.

      Generated code names the dependency type twice: <D>, so that the call has an exact static type and selects the right overload, and type, its erasure, which is checked against the declared parameter type and against every value the provider returns.

      Type Parameters:
      D - the dependency type
      Parameters:
      paramIndex - the zero-based parameter index
      type - the erasure of the parameter's dependency type
      context - the resolution context
      Returns:
      the provider for the paramIndex-th constructor parameter
      Throws:
      InjectionException - if type is not the erasure of the declared parameter type, or, from the provider, if a resolved value is not a type
